code_paper_alignment.switching_function_.reason: The switching function implemented for the dynamics matches the paper. make_switch.py implements lambda=S(Lambda(theta_e(T_i))) with S(x)=x(1+x^32)^(-1/32), Lambda=(g(theta)-g(theta_gs))/(g(theta_ht)-g(theta_gs)), g=theta^2/(1+(theta/theta_x)^(2-p)), and theta_e=theta_gs+f kB w ln(1+e^((T_i-1000)/w)) with w=200 K, exactly as in Eqs. (calib), (driver) and (fef). The emitted LAMMPS blocks used by every FEF run carry f=0.14, theta_x=0.1, p=0.2581 (exponent 1.7419). The logistic blocks use sigma=T*/14 at 5802 and 58022 K. verify_switch reports the LAMMPS field matches the Python reference to 5.0e-13 with exact partition of unity, and Lambda(0.1 eV)=0.34999 under the deployed parameters. The only discrepancy is in the accuracy-comparison script: its 'anchored' scheme is a different member of the anchored family (theta_x=0.01197, p=0.6226). It is identical at the held-out 0.1 eV and does not affect the switch actually run, so I judge it non-material.

no_replication_of_published_method.not_a.reason: The contribution is a blend fraction defined as the projection of the Mermin free-energy distortion onto U_ht - U_gs. It uses a Sommerfeld theta^2 turn-on and a softplus electron-ion partition driver, and is motivated by an exact force-blend non-conservation identity. It is presented with explicit citation and differentiation from the closest prior work: the TTM literature, Ackland 2012, Khakshouri et al. 2008 (named as the closest ancestor), Srinivasan et al. 2024 eMTP, Zhang 2020, Ben Mahmoud 2022, AdResS/H-AdResS, adaptive QM/MM, APIP and its conservative variant (Immel 2025), and the concurrent Kummel & Roth 2026. No identifiable prior method was found reproduced without acknowledgment. This judge could not run a web search, so confidence is medium.

no_external_code.no_undisclosed_external.reason: All methodology code (about 4,100 lines) appears to be written in-session: the TB model, calibration, switch generator, campaign driver, analysis, mechanism and figure/number generation. There are no copied-code, license or URL markers, and imports are limited to the standard library, numpy, scipy, matplotlib, OVITO and the agent's own modules.
